scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Have you
found Annon?

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
You haven't
found him yet?
Then where the
is he, then?!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Oh well...
I'm not sure if I can believe everything you said, but since you found the ring for me, that's good enough. Thank you for your help.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: If you happen to meet Annon during your travels, tell him to come back right away. You can go ahead and continue your adventures now~

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
If I ever
see him again...
He will be ^660000punished^000000...
^666666*grinds teeth*^000000

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
You haven't
found Annon yet?
I see. Oh well, it's alright.
Time isn't an issue for us.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
And by 'us,' I mean '^660000you^000000.' I don't care about your plans or whatever else you may have scheduled, because you're going to make
time for me! Oho ho ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Ah... Is it...?!!
Yes, that's it!
My engagement ring that was
thrown into the water by that stupid Annon!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: Thank you so much! In your honor, our first seven kids will be named after you! Oho ho ho ho ho ho ho~

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Now...
All I gotta do
is find Annon.
Where the hell
did that moron go?!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
^666666*Ahem*^000000
I-I didn't mean
to scare him, all I wanted was
my engagement ring back.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh*^000000
I guess the days
of being a happy bride
are still far away from me...

^3355FFShuda gazes directly
at you with a puppy eyed look.^000000
D-Don't look at me that way!
Alright, alright.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Oh come on, you know everything that happened, and I know you're gonna continue adventuring
around this area.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: I was just asking you to find Annon while you do that. Now, isn't that such a small favor? Thank you for doing this for me~

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: In the meantime, I'll think of how I'm gonna pay back Annon for leaving me in misery! So hurry and find Annon! Hoo ho ho ho ho!

(Why am I always
doing things for other
people anyway?!)

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: Yes, I knew I could count on you! So find Annon! It's my destiny to make him ^660000mine^000000. Hoo ho ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: I haven't seen him around the village for a while. And I don't think he jumped into the water to find my ring, since he's too sissy for that. He probably doesn't have the guts to see me without it.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Will you please tell Annon that
I got my ring back so he can come back to me now? I hope you'll remember that for me, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Huh...?
Did you find my ring?
Show me, show it to me!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
What the...
You got nothing!
Don't lie to me,
bring me my ring!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Hurry up and find
my ring. I'll be waiting
here for the good news.
Oho ho ho ho ho~!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
I feel a little bad asking you this, especially since you're
an outsider.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: But that ring is really important to me. If you could find it for me, I'd be the happiest woman in the whole world.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
So please, I beg you.
Please bring my ring back to me.
I want to live with Annon as a happy couple forever. Can't you understand that?!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Umm...?
Ah, you must be one of the tourists. I'd guide you around and listen to your stories about the outside world, but...

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
I'm reeeally
busy right now.
So very busy.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Huh...?
You don't think I look busy just because I'm standing on one spot and not moving at all?! Oh. My. God. You're so rude!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Now, I've got to find my
engagement ring. If only
my fiancee hadn't
thrown it...
What...?
Lies~!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
What 'what?'
You still think I'm
standing around for my
own amusement or something?!

No no no no...
I meant, I can't
believe that you're
engaged to someone!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Wwwwaaaaaahhhhh!
Wh-who are you to say
something so rude to such a nice lady like myself. Go away, I don't wanna talk to you!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
What lies?
I'm not gonna put up with crap
if you're gonna say something like 'I can't believe you're engaged to someone!'

Whoa whoa whoa~
Calm down, lady.
Hear me out first.
What I'm wondering is...

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
I know, I know.
You're wondering why I'm
standing near the water, right? Well, it's because my ring was thrown there and I've gotta
get it back.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text: What am I doing, talking to a tourist like this? ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 Well, you learned what you wanted to know. I hope you're satisfied now.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Why are you staring at me?
Don't you have anything to do?
No.
No~ and you are an interesting girl.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
No no, that doesn't mean I'm interested in you. Plus I'm
already engaged.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
I see. Hmmm...
You're kind of my type.
Before you think of anything weird, I meant that I think you and me are a lot alike.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Let me introduce myself.
My name is Shuda, I've lived in Ayothaya all my life. Since you don't have anything to do, I have
a favor to ask of you.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: My fiance Annon is always interested in things other than me. I don't understand why, and I don't think I deserve to be ignored!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Anyways, we're engaged
and we got rings for each other...

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: I thought being engaged would improve our relationship. But he just took my ring and threw it into the water.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
I got upset and yelled at him to get my ring back for me, and then
I never saw him after that.
So what I want to ask is...

You want me
to find your
ring, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Ah...
So you know
what I want.
That makes it
much simpler.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
And once I retrieve
the ring, I'll make
him treat me to a much
deserved vacation in Jawaii...

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
...Where I will
^660000enslave^000000 him.
^666666*Grinds teeth*^000000
(...H-Horrifying!)

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: So anyway, I want you to go out and find my engagement ring. Since the water is calm and still around here, the ring is probably still under the water, and hasn't been swept away yet.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
And so, that is my quest for you. It should keep you entertained for a while. So get into the water, and I'll supervise from here.
Oho ho ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Are you gonna just stare and
not help at all? I thought the word adventurer was synonymous
with 'hero,' not 'lazy.'

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
Oh I see...
Don't help strangers, do you?
Well, my name is Shuda, a beautiful damsel waiting for her engagement ring to rise up from the water.

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
There...!
We're not
strangers anymore!
Oho ho ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: Don't you pity me, and my tragic situation? If someone were to help this precious maiden find her ring, she'd be the happiest bride in the whole world.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
And her savior
would be known as
the hero of Ayothaya.
...Say what?!

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Basically, you're gonna find my engagement ring, and I'll be the happiest bride in the whole world and I'll live happily ever after. What's so hard to understand
about that?

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Sure, Annon, he's my fiancee, is spineless and disappears whenever
I say something a little too harsh. What a little girl! Can't he see I'm trying to make him a better man?!

He ran away
from you, didn't he?

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Eh...?
What was that?

^666666*Ahem*^000000
You're way
too good for him.
(I'd have run away myself!)

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
Yes, yes, I know.
But what's important
is that once I get my ring back, Annon will be permanently mine. Till ^660000death do we part^000000.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text:
So, are you
gonna help me or what?!
If you do, me and Annon are gonna name our first seven children after you.

scripts.speaker: Shuda
scripts.text: So go and look under the water! There's no water current, so I'm sure it's still there! What are you waiting for, it's should be an easy swim for you! Oho ho ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Why isn't it coming up from the water? Maybe if I stirred around with a wooden stick...?

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
...?!
What are you
looking at?!
I'm busy, so if you
want something
I can't help you!

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
^666666Stupid tourists, running
around all over Ayothaya,
pestering and bothering
beautiful girls like me...^000000

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Where the
hell is it!?

scripts.speaker: Powerful-Looking Woman
scripts.text:
What are
you looking at?
Haven't you ever seen a delicate damsel sigh before? Leave me the hell alone!

A blood stain?
What's going on?
I should take a look...

^3355FFUnder a giant tree,
you find some bushes with
blood smudged on some
of the leaves.^000000

^3355FFWithin the bushes, you see
that the trail of blood continues, almost as if a bleeding animal struggled to find refuge within
the bushes.^000000
Hmmm....
Scatter the bushes.
Dig up the bushes.

^666666*Cough cough*^000000
It's so dusty!

...Awwww
Oh... Oh God...!

Huh...?
I heard something
from below! Let's
dig it up!

^3355FFYou pull up the bushes,
^3355FFand beneath the dust and
^3355FFshrubbery, you find
a small burrow.^000000

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Wh...who's there?
Shuda?! If that's you,
stay back, or I'll kill myself!
What are you doing here?
I'm not Shuda!

Hey...
What are you doi--
^3355FFHe vanished!^000000

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
Hmmm...?
I sense kindess, sincerity and a general love for mankind in your voice. Verily, you are not Shuda.

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text: You are unfamiliar to me, outsider. I'm unsure of how you found my hiding place, but if you have something to say, make it short!

^3355FFYou dig up the bushes, stirring
up a large, choking cloud of dust.^000000

^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
What a large,
choking cloud
of dust!

^3355FFAs you dig up the bushes, the ground beneath one of the bushes crumbles and you hear a scream
from beneath.^000000

^666666*Cough cough*^000000
...M-my legs!

Hmmm...?
What was that noise?
Ugh, it's awfully dusty.
I better stop digging.
^666666*cough cough cough*^000000
^3355FFYou find that the burrow is empty. It seems Annon has found a new hiding place.^000000
^3355FFYou find a pile of dead bushes under a large tree. The area around the bushes seems awfully dusty.^000000
Huh...?

That looks
like blood!

Hmm...
Yes...
That's definitely blood.

Strange to see
a blood stain in
this kind of place...

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
^666666*...Cough cough*^000000
No...! My hiding place!

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
Hmmm...?
I'm bleeding?!
Oh, how did this happen?
My spiritual training wasn't supposed to go like this...!
Treat his wound first.
Is that you, Annon?
Anyway, I think you need to be treated. Let me check if I have some potions.

Ah...
Here we are,
a White Potion.

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
You mean the White Potion,
the ultimate drink for healing?
I appreciate you doing me this favor. ^666666*Phew*^000000 Now, I feel much better.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Ah, my apologies for not introducing myself earlier.
I am called Annon. You must wondering what I must be doing
here under the ground.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: Well, I'm performing a special exercise for my spiritual training. Though, it may be hard to believe.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
What...?
Shuda sent you?! Oh well...
I thank you for curing me. Now, it's time for me to resume my training.
Wait, I can't let you go! You don't know how hard it was for me to find you! You can't just leave!

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: Hm? Then what is it that you want? I implore you, do not tell Shuda that you have found me. No matter what, I am not going back to her!

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Eh...?
Did you find
her ring already?
Ooh, I was hoping it
would never be found.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: She probably told you that I ran away out of shame for losing the ring, and that if you got the ring back, I'd be happy to return, right?

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Well...
I threw away
that ring on purpose!
I'm serious about not
going back to Shuda.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
It looks like you wish to know more. If you promise me that you will not mention my whereabouts
to Shuda, then I'll explain.
You think the world revolves around you?
What do you want me to do?

You think the world
revolves around you?
You can't just run away!

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Oh, I know, I know!
But you don't understand. Obviously, Shuda is beautiful.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
But our parents arranged our marriage when we were babies.
That kind of arrangement doesn't matter to me, but she obviously cares about it.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
In all honesty, she scares me
to death. Whenever I'm with her,
I can't help but break into a cold sweat. And when she's near, I have nightmares about her. ^666666*Brrr...*^000000

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
She thinks it's funny to electrocute me. and ties me up in
a darkened room and feeds me only Jellopy whenever I don't listen to her. Now can you see why I crave freedom?

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: Of course, if you reveal to her that you've found me, I'll repay your favor. I implore you, just pretend you haven't found me, please?
...Alright, alright.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Thank you so much!
Now, to pay you back, let me use one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: Of course, what I want you to do is to keep me a secret from Shuda. Just forget that you've ever met me, and let Shuda know it was impossible to find me.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text: Besides, even if you help her, all she'll do is offer to name her kids after you. Now... Do you really want that? I know for sure that she and I won't be having children. There's enough evil in the world.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Now, you must be wondering
how I would repay you for your silence. Well, let me show you one of the skills I've learned in my spiritual training.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Let's see...
Let me twist your
arm this way, and
apply pressure here...

Wahhh~!
What the hell
are you doing!
You're hurting me, man!

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Oh, this is a special kind
of massage. Don't worry, it'll
relieve you of fatigue. It's quite heavenly, actually. You'll see~

^3355FF*Snap snap snap*
*Snap snap snap*
*Crack crack crack*
*Crack crack crack*^000000

^3355FFYou feel as though Annon
realigned every bone in your skeleton, placing them in the right spots. Strangely, you feel intense relaxation and refreshment instead of excruciating pain.

Whoa...?
That felt was so great~
It even feels like my mind
has been cleansed too!
You've got a deal!

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Thank you, thank you so much.
Now I can avoid being tied to Shuda, at least for a little longer.

scripts.speaker: Annon
scripts.text:
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I must make good my escape
before others find me.
Good day~!

No way, no way.
He's too seriously
wounded to be cured
with the normal potions
that I have. I'll need
a stronger potion...

Okay, you stay
here for a while.
I'll bring you some
medicine and treat
your wound.

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
No, you don't have to...
^666666*Cough cough cough*^000000
W-wait, don't push
me back inside!
Wahhhhhh~!

Okay, it's time
for me to play doctor!
I don't have much time!
My mission: Bring back an
ultra powerful potion for
this poor guy~

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
Annon...?
Who's that?
I've never heard of him!
I don't know him, okay!
Stop disturbing my training!

Uh...
Hmm, it doesn't seem like you should be yelling with that kind of wound. You sure you're not Annon?

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
I told you!
I've never
heard of him!
L-leave me alone!

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
I have to
hide from Shuda.
^666666*Cries*^000000

scripts.speaker: Haggard Man
scripts.text:
Huh? Who are you?
This isn't a safe place for a tourists! You should leave right away!

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
This place is known to be
teeming with fish. The fish here tend to eat anything they find,
so it's easy to catch them.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
We are providing a fishing rod rental service. Every time you fish, you'll need ^3355FF 1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait, and pay
a rod rental fee of ^3355FF50 Zeny^000000.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
Would you
like to try?
Yes.
No, thanks.

^3355FFYou cast your
fishing line
into the water.^000000
^3355FFYou've hooked a Phen!^000000

^3355FFWhile cooking the Phen, you
find that it's swallowed a Stone.^000000

^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Red Potion.^000000

^3355FFInside of the Phen,
you find a Yellow Potion.^000000

^3355FFThere's nothing inside...
But now you can eat Sushi!^000000

^3355FFYou find
a Flower Ring
inside the Phen.^000000

^3355FFYou find
a Diamond Ring
inside the Phen.^000000

^3355FFYou find a ring
with a name engraved
inside the band.^000000

^3355FFYou take the
engagement ring.^000000

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text: Remember, you need ^3355FF1 Monster's Feed^000000 to use as bait and ^3355FF50 zeny^000000 to rend a rod.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
No problem,
come back anytime you
want. Fishing relaxes
the mind and makes you
feel at peace...

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
The fish here tend
to eat anything they find.
When you gut them, you can
often find interesting things inside.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
So when you get a chance,
why don't you sit down, relax
and enjoy some quiet fishing?

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
Welcome, long time no see!
It seems people learned that you found some kind of fortune from fishing here. After word got around, I've been getting lots
of customers.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
I understand that you want
fish, but right now there
aren't any fishing spots
for you at the moment.

scripts.speaker: Dannai
scripts.text:
Please let other
people have their
chance to find their
own fortunes.
^3355FFYou find footprints heading to the ^5C3317North^3355FF. It looks like somebody was in quite a hurry, just like the villager said!^000000

^3355FFYou find another set of footprints. It seems that somebody was running away from something. These prints are heading to the ^5C3317East^3355FF. You'd better follow them to see what
you can find.^000000

^3355FFThe footprints end around this area. Whoever was running must
have been exhausted and stumbled on something. Perhaps the owner of the footprints is nearby...^000000

^3355FFAs you follow the footprints,
you arrive at the '^5C3317Entrance of the Shrine^3355FF.' Whoever this person was, he just ran into the second level.^000000

^3355FFYou find the same footprints
in this place. It seems pretty
dangerous, and you wonder why
anyone would come here. The
footprints continue towards
the ^5C3317North^3355FF.^000000

^3355FFThe trail of footprints
continue here, and seem
to look more freshly made.^000000.

^3355FFHmm...?
There's something here...^000000
Ignore.
^5C3317Investigate.^000000
Well, it's probably nothing. But which way should I go now?
Why, this is a pack of White Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...

Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.
Why, this is a pack of Yellow Potions. Whoever owned these must have dropped these by accident. Hmm, I could use these for later...

Wait...
There are more
footprints heading
toward the ^5C3317East^000000.
I better look
into this.

scripts.speaker: Rat
scripts.text:
^FF0000Squeak!
^FF0000Squeak Squeak!^000000

^8C1717Wah^000000!
What was that?!

^3355FFIt was just a rat.
It feels awful silly to be scared by just a little rat, does it not?^000000

^3355FFYou find another trail
of footprints that heads
towards the ^5C3317East^3355FF.^000000

^3355FFWhere is he...?
He seems to have gone
deep into the dungeon.
Just looking for this
guy is exhausting...^000000
^3355FFYou find traces of blood. Whoever was running in this direction may have been wounded. The trail of blood leads to the ^5C3317North^3355FF.^000000

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Weird...
Why was that guy
running into the
shrine like that?
That really
bothers me...

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Oh, aren't you
from Midgard?
Hello there~

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Ah...
You heard me talking to myself? Well, I didn't see who he was but, some guy ran into the forest which leads to the shrine. He seemed really terrified of something.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text: He came from out of nowhere, so he scared the crap out of me. Do you think he could be a criminal?

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text: Ah! I think, in his intense fear, he was screaming something about some kind of '^FF0000Shuda^000000,' or whatever. But what could it possibly mean?

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text: Oh well, don't worry. All of our villagers aren't like that. Anyway, I hope you enjoy your travels in Ayothaya.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Recently, it seems that
our village has been receiving
more tourism, and I can see that
our village is being influenced
in a positive way.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Ah...
While you're here,
why don't you taste some
authentic Ayothaya cuisine
for yourself?

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
We're known for our
spicy and sweet seafood,
and there are some nice
restaurants around here.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text: Anyway, I'm sure that you'll like it. I hope that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Ah~
I've got this craving for Ms. Mali the Spicy's food, especially her 'Tom Yum Goong.'

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
I think it's the
most delicious dish
in the entire world!

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text:
Oh hello~
I can tell from your clothes that you must be from Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Tham
scripts.text: I hope that you enjoy your stay here, and that you come visit Ayothaya as often as you can~

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
Oh...!
You must be a traveller.
I have a tale you may wish to hear if you're interested in listening.
What is it?
I know what the story is.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text: Ayothaya has a long history. Perhaps it looks calm and peaceful now, but in the past our village was terrorized by a terrible creature.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
This beast is known to us as
the ^660000Sa-mhing Tiger^000000, which used
to dwell deep in the ancient ruins.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
The Sa-mhing Tiger is addicted
to the taste of human flesh. It has been known to transform into the shape of a person it has eaten in order to lure out his family and friends.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text: The local people are still afraid that the creature might transform into someone they know, and sneak into their homes to eat them.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
However, there is one way you can identify the Sa-mhing Tiger from a human being. Since it's a tiger, it cannot do some of the things
humans are taught to do,
such as light a match.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
So, if by any chance you see
a friend acting strangely all
of a sudden, ask him to strike
a match. Make sure he is not
the Sa-mhing Tiger.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
However...
I'm not sure if this actually works or not. I guess the best thing to do is just run for your life if you even suspect someone of being
the Sa-mhing Tiger.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
Do you believe
in the existance
of man-eating tigers?
Well, not really.
Yes, I do and I think they're scary!

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
Umm...
Oh well. My late grandfather told me about the Sa-mhing Tiger when
I was a little kid. Of course,
I haven't seen it.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text: The closest thing I've seen to the Sa-mhing Tiger was a golden cat with a bell. Somehow, I don't think it ate men.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
Run for your life if you ever encounter the Sa-mhing Tiger!
It'll eat you alive!

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
If you're interested in finding
out more about the story, I can introduce you to someone who
knows that creature more than
anyone else.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text: Why don't you talk to Boonthom? He's a pretty strange person, but there's something about him...

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text: Ah well, you'll see what I'm talking about. I hope he'll help you learn more about that evil creature.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
You do now?
Then be careful!
It'll eat you alive!

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
How are you?
If you're interested
in the Sa-mhing Tiger,
please go talk to Boonthom.

scripts.speaker: Dusit
scripts.text:
But beware!
The Sa-mhing Tiger might be
closer to you than you expect!

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
You...!
Isn't it....!
Oooooohhhhhhh!

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Never mind.
Hah! I've lost my
train of thought.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: So have you come to me to seek help? I can see the fear in your eyes. Let me gaze into your soul, and see what your fear is for myself. Hmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
What...!
I see that you dread the Sa-mhing Tiger! I haven't heard any news of that monster for a long time...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
A long time ago,
the Sa-mhing Tiger
really did roam the village
and ate innocent people.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
However, its terror
was brought to an end when it
was finally captured. I was one of those involved in capturing the Sa-mhing Tiger.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
I insisted killing on it, but the other people were too afraid to do so. Instead, the Sa-mhing Tiger
was locked in a cave inside of the ancient ruins.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
I believe that was at least 10 years ago. Perhaps it's already dead by now. However, no one
knows how powerful the tiger truly
is. It may still be alive.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: I don't think we need to worry about it though. It is locked up and there it shall remain.
I want to explore the ancient ruins.
Locked up! Good! I'm not afraid!

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
You...
You are strange.
You want to explore the ancient ruins. Do all adventurers disregard their safety like that?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: It's your choice. But remember, it is very dangerous to go through the path to the center of the building. Usually, I forbid it.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
But if you want to go in,
I can give you some useful tips.
Would you like to listen?
If it's that dangerous, I'd rather not try.
Sure!

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
You made a good decision.
You'd better be careful if
you want to stay alive.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Umm, okay.
Since you're
that interested...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: If you wish to enter the ancient building, you must have protection against evil spirits and malice.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Even if you can
wield the power of
holiness, you will still need the spiritual security of our land.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
There are many ghosts and
demons within the cave, and they will attack people who do not possess holy power... Like you.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
I can make you an object
containing this holy power if you wish. In order to make it, I will need some materials.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Please come back
when you prepare all
the materials.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Not afraid
of it, are you?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Excellent!
Now you have brought
everything I need. Let me make
the thing for you as promised...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Pffff pffff...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Even if you lose this, don't worry. Just bring me the materials, and
I will make you another one.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
The ancient building consists
of 2 levels. Before you enter the 2nd underground level, please return to me so that I can tell you how to enter that place.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Did you forget what materials
you need to create my object of holy power? Please listen
carefully this time.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: See you later.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Excellent! Now you have brought everything I need, let me make the thing for you as I promised...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Pffff pffff...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Even if you lose this, don't worry. Just bring me the materials, I can make you another one.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: If you lose the holy threads, don't worry. I can make some more for you. Just gather the following items.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: See you later.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: You finally started seeking the tiger. I hope that you will be safe from harm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Feel free to ask
me for help at anytime.

I copied down this
message while exploring
the dungeon. Would you
take a look at this?

scripts.speaker: Stone Slate
scripts.text:
^333333Do not enter the
2nd underground level
...is danger... You wil...
...encounter... tiger...^000000

scripts.speaker: Stone Slate
scripts.text:
^333333You must kill... In order to do... MUST... How to go... the 2nd underground level...
You need more... Holy power... in order to... Otherwise, it's impossible...^000000

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
That was written by one of my comrades who entered the ruins,
as he regretted letting the tiger live, lest it return.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: If you were able to find this note, you must have strong determination to venture through the ruins.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
As you can guess from the
note, the 2nd underground level is very very dangerous. You will need holy threads that contain even more holy protection.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Now, go and gather some materials so that I can create more powerful holy threads for you.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Return to me
once you have
gathered everything.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmm~
You've brought
everything. Quite
the enthusiastic one,
aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Pffff pffff...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Even if you lose this, don't worry. Just bring me the materials, and
I will make you another one.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Didn't I tell you
what I need to make
a more powerful
holy thread?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Return to me
with those items
and I will craft
more powerful holy
threads for you.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Those threads
will protect you
from the spiritual
dangers, but it's up
to you to defend yourself
from monster attacks, okay?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Pffff pffff...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Didn't I tell you
what I need to make
a more powerful
holy thread?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Huh...!
You must have seen something.
I can tell by the gloomy look on your face, and the shadow looming over your soul.

I found
this old letter
in the ruins.

scripts.speaker: Old Letter
scripts.text: ^333333Dear, Boonthom...I was a fool...There is Sa-mhing Tig'...One who ....my remains... Please take...to Boonthom...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
I see...
Oh, my dear
old friend...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Thank you for your trouble.
My friend left that box for me.
But I guess he would wish to give that box to the person who found his remains.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: If you wish to explore the building again, but you don't have any holy thread, feel free to ask me at anytime.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Best of luck on your
expeditions, brave
adventurer~

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Lost the
holy threads
somehow, did you?
With the items you
have, I'll simply
make more of them.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmm.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Pffff pffff...

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Here you go.
Please take these holy threads.
With this, you will be able to enter the ruins with less worry.

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Didn't I tell you
what I need to make
a more powerful
holy thread?

scripts.speaker: Boonthom
scripts.text: Ooooohmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Huh...?
I feel it!
I can feel the
power of holiness!
It's coming from you!

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
I guess you can go ahead
into the ruins. So that's
what you want? To explore
this area?

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
I would suggest
against coming inside.
Even the local people
fear this area.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text: If the Sa-mhing Tiger wasn't around, there would still be all the evil spirits in this place. Even with the holy thread, this place is still dangerous.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
So what do you want?
Do you still want to
explore the area,
adventurer?
Yes.
No! I'm too afraid of the ruins now.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
It seems you adventurers are tempted by the thrill of danger,
or you've all got some death wish.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Oh well, that's none of my business. After all, you already
have a holy spirit. Still, be careful. You might not want to go to the 2nd underground level of the ruins.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
As you Midgardians
say, 'curiousity killed the cat.'
Anyway, go for it!

^3355FFHe shoved you off the hill
and you plummet like a rock.^000000

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Good decision!
As I expected, you're
smart enough not to
stupidly jeopardize your life.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
If I were you, I wouldn't
even dare to approach
the ruins down over there.

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Anyone who doesn't have the protection of a holy spirit will be easy game for the evil creatures living there. You'd be killed in
no time at all!

scripts.speaker: Puraim
scripts.text:
Go back, adventurer.
If you wish to explore
this area, you'd better
show me some holy spirit.

scripts.speaker: Aik
scripts.text:
So, how was your expedition?
I hope that the evil spirits will not follow you outside of the ruins, and haunt your dreams.

scripts.speaker: Aik
scripts.text:
When you go back,
remember to ward off
the evil from your mind.
Otherwise you will encounter
trouble later...

scripts.speaker: Aik
scripts.text:
So, would you
like to go back?
Yes.
No, I need to look around more...

scripts.speaker: Aik
scripts.text:
Alright then...
Here we go...

^3355FFHe suddenly grabbed you
and hurled you up into the air!^000000

scripts.speaker: Aik
scripts.text:
I see.
Take care.

^3355FFYou look down and see a pool
of water in the distance. It looks like a long drop to the bottom.^000000

^3355FFYou are filled
with apprehension,
After all, if you fall down,^000000

^3355FFYou pick

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Do you know what the
most popular cuisine
of this village is?

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Ayothaya is world famous
for its regional cuisine, but
out of all Ayothayan dishes,
'^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000' is the best.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Tom Yum Goong is a type
of soup that is very spicy. Try it once, and you will be amazed by its profound taste. Try it twice, and you will be enraptured by its tantalizing aroma.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
It's really one of the most delicious foods in the world!
Everyone in the world would
want to try this at least once in his lifetime. So, would you like
to try some?
Sure thing.
No, thanks. I hate spicy food.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Okay...!
Now who would be
best for preparing
Tom Yum Goong for you?
Hmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Everyone in the village
knows how to make it, but
I recommend that you go
visit ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
She is the best cook when it
comes to Tom Yum Goong!
Why don't you ask her
to cook you some?

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Oh I see...
However, when you
change your mind,
please come back.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Ah, you wanna know
where ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000 is?
Well, there's not too many places
a cook would stay other than in
a restaurant, right? Hahaha~

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
Golden Ayothaya...
Although I've grown
up in this village,
I still think my village
is magnificient and beautiful.

scripts.speaker: Einon
scripts.text:
What do you think?
Wouldn't you agree with me?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Hello, there!
I am called Mali the Spicy.
All of my dishes always amaze
my customers with their tempting scents and deep flavors.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I am especially proud of my
^3131FFTom Yum Goong^000000, which is the
best in the village. I suppose
it's my fate to cook the greatest Tom Yum Goong ever.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Oh I see...
You want me to cook
Tom Yum Goong for you,
don't you?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Honestly, I've been really
busy ever since I opened this restaurant. If you really wish to taste my Tom Yum Goong, would
you do something for me?
Sure!
Eh... I dunno.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
First, would you get
the ingredients to make
Tom Yum Goong for me? I'll need some ^CE0000Shrimps^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and ^CE0000Lemons^000000.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Remember, Shrimp is the main ingredient of this dish. So, the fresher the Shrimp, the tastier your food will be.
Where can I find them?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I expected you
to ask me that.
For Shrimps, look around
the beach. You should see
a lot of them there.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
However, you might have a hard time finding them since you haven't done that before. So just buy some Shrimp from the guy who sells
the freshest Shrimp around.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
If you mention
my name, that guy
might give you a discount.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
His name is ^3131FFThongpool^000000.
He will be somewhere around the village selling Shrimps. Go and ask him to give you 20 Shrimps to cook Tom Yum Goong.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I understand this might be difficult to do, but it's worth
a try if you really want to taste the best Tom Yum Goong.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Errr...
What's wrong with these Shrimp?
They all have these scratches and rips in them! I can't believe Thongpool sold such bad Shrimp
to his customers!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I'm so sorry, but
I can't cook the best
Tom Yum Goong with
these Shrimp.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I know it's an inconvenience, but would you go back to Thongpool
and ask him to give you the freshest Shrimp to cook the best
Tom Yum Goong?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Ah, you came back!
Now, let me see what
you've brought. Hmm...
These are...

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
The freshest Shrimp that
I've been looking for! Well done~
With these big and fresh Shrimp,
I can cook the best Tom Yum Goong for you! Thank you so much!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: It will be a perfect food with the natural sweetness of the Shrimp, the sourness of Lemons and a little bit of fish sauce!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Oh... Right.
But we only have Shrimp.
Now, I want you to bring
me some ^CE0000Lemons^000000.
Where can I find Lemons?
I hate sour food. I'd better quit!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
A few days ago, I saw a good
Lemon tree while taking a walk.
But this tree belongs to an ordinary man who's not a Fruit Merchant.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I'm not sure whether
or not he'd sell Lemons
to you, but you can try,
I guess.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
What a stupid...!
If you quit just because you really hate sour flavors, you must not be that eager to have my Tom Yum Goong!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Once you taste my
Tom Yum Goong, you'll
regret what you just said!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Huh...?
What did you do
with the Shrimps?
You didn't eat them
on the way here, did you?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Make sure you ask
Mr. Thongpool to give
you 20 Shrimps.
Now hurry~

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
You think these are
the best quality Lemons?
Take a closer look!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
The skin of these
Lemons lack luster
and they don't even smell
fresh! They're just
common Lemons!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Welcome back!
Wow, you came back
really fast! Okay, let me
see the Lemons
you brought?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Wow, great!
These are really fresh Lemons!
How could you bring all of these by yourself? Thanks for your trouble~

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Now, you should go buy
some ^CE0000Chiles^000000 and some
other materials in the Market.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
When you talk
to the Merchants
in the Market, they
will know what you want.
Okay, I'll be right back.
Ah, I'm tired now. Let me take a rest first...

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: See you in a bit~

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
It's your call.
But remember...
The Shrimps might go bad
while you're taking a rest.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Huh...?
What did you
do with Lemons?
You didn't eat them
all on the way here, did you?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Alright...
I'm counting on you
to get the best Lemons
from the guy that owns that tree.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Somehow, you've got
to get those high quality
Lemons so that I can make
some Tom Yum Goong!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
I don't understand...
Where did you get these
bad ingredients?! Didn't
I tell you that my
Tom Yum Goong
requires the best?!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: I know you've been working hard to do me this favor. I hope you'll put forth that last little bit of effort to finish this.

scripts.speaker: Malli the Spicy
scripts.text: Please go take a look in the Market. I don't doubt that it will be a good experience. After all, my fantastic Tom Yum Goong is waiting for you!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Now...
Everything is all set!
Before we start, let me
check the materials.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
^CE0000Shrimp^000000, ^CE0000Chiles^000000, ^CE0000Lemons^000000...
Fish sauce and other little things...

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Perfect!
Shall we begin?

^FF0031*Chop chop*^000000
^FF9C00*Tup tup tup*^000000
^639CFF*Pu pu^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Wah^00009Cah^0000FFahhhh^0063FFaaaahhh^000000!

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Here's your
Tom Yum Goong!
Ah~ This taste,
this scent... Yeah.
I know I did a good job.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Do you know what is the secret of Tom Yum Goong? It isn't simply just food. This has the power to heal you, and help you get into better shape.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Because...
It contains the
power of God.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Okay...!
I'm giving you
10 Tom Yum Goong
free of charge~

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Thank you for all the trouble that you have been though to get these ingredients. It would make me happy if you shared Tom Yum Goong with your friends.

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Share the flavor of Ayothaya, and let them know how beautiful our land is. It was good to see you, take care now~

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text: Huh? What did you do with the Chiles? You didn't eat them all on the way here, did you?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Hmm...
You seem to be carrying too many things. Why don't you free up some space in your inventory first, and then come back?

scripts.speaker: Mali the Spicy
scripts.text:
Ah...!
So busy, so busy!
My customers never get tired of
the taste of my Tom Yum Goong!
Heh heh heh~!

- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Come adventurers,
take a look! I have
plenty of Shrimp!

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
You're looking for Shrimp,
aren't you? How many Shrimp
do you need? Twenty? Forty?
I need Shrimp for Tom Yum Goong.
Err, they look expensive.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Ah! I guess Ms. Mali the Spicy recommended me to you. I guess
that also means you want to buy them in bulk?

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
After all,
you'll need a larger
amount of Shrimp to
cook Tom Yum Goong.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Oh yes, you will need 20 Shrimps for Ms. Mali's Tom Yum Goong.
I'll even give you a discount:
11,000 zeny for 20 shrimps.
What do you say?
I will take them.
I could get 100 Jellopies for that much!

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Good, now you have the
freshest Shrimp in this village! It's time for you to go back and ask Ms. Mali to cook them for you.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Awww...
You're carrying too much stuff with you. I don't think you can carry more than what you have right now.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Awww...
You don't have
enough money.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Well well well...
You might fill your hungry stomach with that many Jellopies but they wouldn't taste as good as my Shrimp!

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
What...?
Do you think
it's expensive?
But the fantastic taste
of Tom Yum Goong
is priceless!

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Mmm...?
Did you need
more Shrimps?
Would you like
to buy more?
Yes!
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
There you go~
The freshest Shrimp you can ever get in this village, and maybe even the world!

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Awww...
You're carrying too much stuff with you. I don't think you can carry more than what you have right now.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Awww...
You don't have
enough money.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Good, now you have gotten the freshest shrimps in this village!
It's time for you to go back and ask Ms. Mali to cook for you.

scripts.speaker: Thongpool
scripts.text:
Welcome, welcome!
I've got the best Shrimp caught in the cleanest waters in the world~!

- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Umm...?
You don't need
more Lemons
again, do you?
No.
Give me Lemons, old man!
Can I have some more Lemons, please?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Then why don't you taste
the Lemons I gave you last time? They're really sour, but also very delicious!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
What...!?
What's wrong with you, kid?
What have you done with the
Lemons I gave you last time?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Oh, I am sorry....recently my lemon storage
was attacked by ^3131FF'Leaf Cats'^000000 that are roaming around the Shrine.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
I wish that I could help you,
but I don't even have enough lemons for my business.
If you need lemons, why don't you go hunt them?

- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please enlighten your weight -
- and try again. -

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hello, there?
Did you need
some help...?
I need some Lemons.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Umm...
Lemons?
As you see, I have plenty
of Lemons on my tree.
Do you really need some?
Yes, I will pay you.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
I started growing this Lemon tree as a hobby, but I didn't expect to have such a good harvest of sweet,
succulent Lemons.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Did you just say you were
going to pay me for the Lemons?
Oh, you've got me wrong. I don't intend to sell these.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
But...
I'm more than willing
to share some of them with
you, but only if you can...

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Play a small game with me!
How about that? I've been so bored to death. Even an old man like me needs to enjoy himself!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hahahaha~!
What do you say?
Would you like to try?
Sure, why not!
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Good!
The game I want us
to play is an easy
children's game.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
^660000Rock,
Paper, Scissors!^000000
Perhaps you've heard
of it in your land.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Nuh-uh, don't look at me like that. I'm an old man, and I want to play this game and re-live my youth
a little bit. You'll understand when you're my age.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Alright, if you win
^3131FF3^000000 out of ^3131FF5^000000 matches,
The Lemons are yours.
Are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Okay...
As you kids say,
^990000Let's get eXtreme!^000000

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Rock!
Paper!
Scissors!
Scissors
Rock
Paper

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Yes...!
Oh my God, yes!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
What...?
I don't believe it!
Bah.. !

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
No...!
Sacrilege!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Bwahahaha!
You lose, kid!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Heh heh~
Young fool!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Noooo...!
This cannot be!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hmpf.
It's a draw.
One more time!
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
You... won.
I'm so exhausted.
I guess I can't compete
with you youngsters
anymore. Ha ha ha!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
As promised,
I shall share some
of my Lemons with you.
Grab as many as you want!
^3355FFYou have plucked
10 Lemons from the tree.^000000

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hmm...
Looks like you need a lot of them. Oh well, that's fine with me. I had a good time with you.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Don't forget this though:
Don't be selfish, and always share what you have with others. That's one of the most important values for human beings.

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha!
Victory is mine!
Looks like you won't be getting
any Lemons for now! But feel free to challenge me anytime!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Afraid are we?
There's no fooling you:
I'm one of the best at games!

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Hmm...
Now what can
I possibly do
with all these
Lemons?

scripts.speaker: Mr. Jun
scripts.text:
Feel free to
ask me for help
any time, okay?

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Hello, there~
Are you looking for
ingredients to make
Tom Yum Goong?

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Let's see...
I'm selling chiles,
fish sauce, and some
spices and flavorings
you'll need. I'll sell
it all to you for 2,000 zeny.
Thanks, I'll take it.
It's a rip-off, man!

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Thank you.
I hope you will enjoy
your Tom Yum Goong~

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Uh oh...
It looks like
you're carrying
too much stuff
right now.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
I can't give you
anything if you don't
have the room to hold it!

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Right now, it looks
like you don't have the
money to buy what you
need from me.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Don't say that.
My prices are always
reasonable. I want you to know
that I'm a respectable Merchant.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
I thought I provided you
with enough ingredients, but
now that I think about it, I don't
know how much Tom Yum Goong
you're making.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Would you like to
buy some more Chilis?
No, thanks.
Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text: Fare well~

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Thank you,
come again!

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Uh oh...
It looks like
you're carrying
too much stuff
right now.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
I can't give you
anything if you don't
have the room to hold it!

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Right now, it looks
like you don't have the
money to buy what you
need from me.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
Hello there!
Ever try a Chili before?

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdom
scripts.text:
Despite its tiny appearance,
it has a very strong flavor. It's also hot and spicy, so you should be careful when you eat one.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text: The people of Ayothaya enjoy sensational food with distinct, spicy flavors. In Ayothayan cuisine, we use things like Chilis, garlic, ginger and cilantro.

scripts.speaker: Merchant Thongdum
scripts.text:
I'm selling Chilis,
so if you need any,
please come to me~
